description: This file defines an interface IInvokable for asynchronously invokable objects in the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It includes methods for invocation targeting, argument management, method information retrieval, and cancellation/timing features.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the invocation target using an ITargetHolder instance.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Performs the asynchronous invocation of the target.

methods.name: GetArgumentCount
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments for the invocation.

methods.name: GetArgument
methods.description: Retrieves the argument at the specified index.

methods.name: SetArgument
methods.description: Sets the argument at the specified index.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method to invoke.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the interface.

methods.name: GetActivityName
methods.description: Returns the activity name, combining interface and method names.

methods.name: GetMethod
methods.description: Provides the MethodInfo object for the method.

methods.name: GetInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the Type object for the interface.

methods.name: GetDefaultResponseTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the default response timeout, if any.

methods.name: GetCancellationToken
methods.description: Provides the CancellationToken for this invocation.

methods.name: TryCancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the invocation request.
